name: Steal a Drill
desc:
🛠️ Welcome to Steal to Drill
👍 Like the game & join the group for exclusive rewards!
🌟 New Drill Machine drops at 5000 LIKES!

🔄 New Update Is Out:
🔴Blood Moon Event!
🔥New Highligted Blood Moon Drills!
🦠Bug Fixes!

🕹️ How to Play:
⛏️ Buy and upgrade your Drill Machines
💣 Sneak into other bases and steal their loot
💰 Earn cash per second from your drills
🔁 Rebirth to unlock stronger drills and earn multipliers
🎭 Use gadgets to defend, troll, or outsmart your enemies!

📱 Play on PC, Mobile, or Tablet – grind anytime, anywhere
🔥 New drills, updates & chaos gear added regularly!
